approach.en: k slots used in a circle: head is the front, size counts the messages, and a push writes at (head + size) % k, so the rear wraps around to the slots a pull freed.
approach.ko: k개의 칸을 원형으로 씁니다. head가 맨 앞이고 size가 메시지 수이며, push는 (head + size) % k에 쓰므로 뒤쪽이 한 바퀴 돌아 pull로 비운 칸을 다시 씁니다.

caption.en: FixedRing(3) makes 3 slots, all 0, with head = 0 and size = 0: an empty queue. It returns null.
caption.ko: FixedRing(3): 0으로 채운 칸 3개를 만들고 head = 0, size = 0인 빈 큐로 시작합니다. null을 반환합니다.

items.why: size is the field FixedRing keeps; it counts the slots not faded, which can wrap past the end, so no span can draw it

caption.en: push(1): it goes into slot (0 + 0) % 3 = 0; size becomes 1, and push returns true.
caption.ko: push(1): (0 + 0) % 3 = 0번 칸에 넣습니다. size는 1이 되고 true를 반환합니다.

items.why: size is the field FixedRing keeps; it counts the slots not faded, which can wrap past the end, so no span can draw it

caption.en: push(2): it goes into slot (0 + 1) % 3 = 1; size becomes 2, and push returns true.
caption.ko: push(2): (0 + 1) % 3 = 1번 칸에 넣습니다. size는 2가 되고 true를 반환합니다.

items.why: size is the field FixedRing keeps; it counts the slots not faded, which can wrap past the end, so no span can draw it

items.why: size is the field FixedRing keeps; it counts the slots not faded, which can wrap past the end, so no span can draw it

caption.en: push(4): size = 3 = k, so the queue is full; nothing is overwritten, and push returns false.
caption.ko: push(4): size = 3 = k라 큐가 가득 찼습니다. 아무것도 덮어쓰지 않고 false를 반환합니다.

items.why: size is the field FixedRing keeps; it counts the slots not faded, which can wrap past the end, so no span can draw it
